# E0232: a minor version changes a validator the checker has no rule for

The compatibility checker knows a fixed set of validators and how each narrows a
value. A minor version that adds or changes one it has no rule for cannot be
shown compatible.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
name: "ship"
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				n: int
			}
		}
		"1": {
			schema: {
				n: int & matchN(1, [>0, <0])
			}
		}
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0232]: n in schema 0.1 must now satisfy matchN(1, [>0, <0]), for which the checker has no rule
  --> lineage.cue:11:5
   |
11 |                 n: int & matchN(1, [>0, <0])
   |                 ^
   |
   = note: schema 0.1 is declared as a minor version of 0.0, so every instance of schema 0.0 must be an instance of it (compatibility rule unknown-validator)
   = help: change the schema so the checker can decide, or make this version 1.0
```
